**PotentialPatina 1.0.3**: a new, more polished look.

- Barlow fonts, raised panels with soft shadows, glowing amber knob arcs, even-sized button labels and darker display wells. The same controls in the same places.

Saved projects keep working. **Download** `PotentialPatina-1.0.3-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
